outcome: maternal hemodynamics (blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate)
cohort: The study included 72 term parturient with ASA PS II undergoing cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: The addition of intrathecal fentanyl to hyperbaric bupivacaine significantly reduced the incidence of intraoperative visceral pain during cesarean delivery, without affecting maternal hemodynamics or neonatal APGAR scores.
mod_finding: The addition of intrathecal fentanyl reduced intraoperative visceral pain during cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
